'''Pavel Bečka''' (born 7 November 1970) is a former Czech professional [[basketball]] player.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.easycredit-bbl.de/de/statistiken/spieler/portraits/p/1711-pavel-becka/|title=easyCredit - 1711 Pavel BECKA|website=easycredit-bbl.de}}</ref> Bečka mainly played as a [[center (basketball)|center]].

==Professional career==
Bečka spent the majority of his pro career with [[EWE Baskets Oldenburg]]. His jersey [[EWE Baskets Oldenburg#Retired numbers|number 8 was retired by the club]].

==National team career==
Bečka also represented the senior [[Czechoslovakia men's national basketball team|Czechoslovakia national team]], and later the senior [[Czech national basketball team|Czech Republic national team]]. He played at the [[1991 EuroBasket]], and at the [[1999 EuroBasket]].
